name: Estelle Ruellan
biography: Estelle is a Threat Intelligence Researcher at Flare. With a background in Mathematics and Criminology, Estelle lost her way into cybercrime and is now playing with lines of code to help computers make sense of the cyber threat landscape. She presented at conferences like ShmooCon 2025, Hack.lu 2024, eCrime APWG 2024 in Boston and the 23rd Annual European Society of Criminology Conference (EUROCRIM 2023) in Florence.
